title: Faux Linen Valance
text: Faux Linen Valance. Faux Linen Valances....I purchased these for some odd small windows I have that need some sun deflection. They look a little like burlap really..in look and touch.... but I guess you could call that a "faux linen" look of sorts... always update my reviews if I think new info would be helpful.
